$notYetAppliedOrdinals_note: 0030 (CEO Notebook) and 0031 (Business Transformation Digital Intake) are written, CI-verified and UNAPPLIED to production. Verified 2026-09-08 by rebuilding all 47 migrations from empty on PostgreSQL 17.6 and fingerprinting both databases: the only objects the repository produces that production lacks are 0030's two functions and seven vstudio.notes columns, and 0031's `intake` schema. Production contains no HL-BOS object the repository does not produce.

reconciliations.mechanism: Option D -- repository filename reconciliation (git mv, SQL content preserved)
reconciliations.$comment: Production had drifted from the repository on 17 version identifiers, and the repository's manifest wrongly declared all 47 migrations applied at repository versions. Because `supabase db push` decides what to apply by version, that would have re-run 17 already-applied migrations -- including two data backfills (0042, 0044). Renaming the repository files to production's applied versions makes both the drift check and `db push` correct without touching production. Equivalence was established two ways: normalized-SQL comparison of each repository file against production's stored statements, and a full from-empty rebuild on PostgreSQL 17.6 whose schema fingerprint (columns, functions, RLS, policies across all 20 HL-BOS schemas) matches production exactly, apart from unapplied 0030 and 0031.

absorbedProductionVersions.$comment: Migration versions recorded in production whose effect a repository file already contains, so they have no file of their own. They are NOT foreign and NOT missing: a from-empty rebuild reaches the same schema without them. Declared here so the drift check recognises them instead of reporting them as out-of-band.

sharedDatabase.$comment: The canonical project is NOT exclusively HL-BOS. Other products' migrations have been applied to the same database out of band. They are declared here so the drift check can tell 'someone else's product' apart from 'an unexplained change to ours'. HL-BOS does not own, test, or reproduce these, and none of them touches an HL-BOS schema -- verified 2026-09-08 by a full from-empty rebuild whose fingerprint matches production.
